## Summary

Explain the maintainer problem, the intended policy outcome, and the scope of this change.

## Compatibility

Describe policy-schema, CLI, action-input, report-schema, or consumer compatibility impact. Write `Not applicable` only when no public contract changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] parser/policy tests added or updated
- [ ] No credentials
- [ ] no private events or proprietary repository source included

State the tools used and include any validation that could not be executed.

## Security impact

Explain possible bypasses, token or workflow permission changes, untrusted input handling, and why the selected event/checkout model is safe.

## Public boundary

Confirm that reports, fixtures, logs, and examples contain only synthetic or public data.

## AI assistance

State whether AI tools were used, what they changed, and how generated output was reviewed by the maintainer.
